item.name: Gold Shop
item.cardSummary: The general Gold exchange for progression items. Its exact shelves, prices, limits, and refresh state need a live check.
item.resetRule: Read the current shop panel for limits and reset.

item.name: Wandering Trader Sentaku
item.cardSummary: A roaming Gem trader that can offer unit and equipment reroll or lock items when present.
item.access: Appears in-game on a live schedule
item.stockRule: Can offer Trait Crystals, Stat Rerolls, Stat Locks, Equipment Rerolls, and Equipment Locks.
item.resetRule: Spawn time, stay duration, price, and quantity must be checked live.

item.name: General Raid Shop
item.cardSummary: Spends Raid Tokens earned across raids on reroll, lock, and Sprite supplies with fixed purchase limits.
item.stockRule: Limited stock with fixed purchase caps.
item.resetRule: Documented stock does not restock after it sells out.

item.name: Spirit City Shop
item.cardSummary: A map-specific raid exchange that uses Spirit Tokens for Spirit City upgrades and rewards, separate from the shared Raid Shop.
item.stockRule: Map-specific limited stock, including Spirit City upgrades and rewards.
item.resetRule: Documented limited stock does not reset after purchase.

item.name: Tournament Shop
item.cardSummary: Turns competitive Crowns into tournament rewards. The payout rules and shop rotation belong to the current tournament panel.
item.resetRule: Check the current leaderboard payout and shop timer.

item.name: Expedition Shop
item.cardSummary: Spends Expedition Coins on materials, resources, and reroll supplies inside the Expedition progression loop.
item.resetRule: Check live cost, purchase cap, and expiry before buying.

item.name: Event Shop
item.cardSummary: A temporary exchange for the active event's currency and upgrade rewards. Its value disappears with the event schedule, so timers matter here.
item.stockRule: Stock and currency change with the event.
item.resetRule: Confirm deadline and currency carry-over in the live panel.
